subject.title: /learn's skill-authoring-and-apply pipeline has no owner gate, unlike the equivalent plugin-install path

question: Where should the owner boundary be enforced for Skill Workshop lifecycle writes and same-chat approval resolution?
rationale: The safest fix must close the privilege path without accidentally breaking unrelated plugin approval flows that intentionally use same-chat fallback.

options.title: Gate Skill Workshop lifecycle writes
options.body: Require owner/operator.admin or an explicit configured approver for `/learn`-driven Skill Workshop lifecycle approval and direct `skill_workshop` apply/reject/quarantine paths, with regression tests for authorized non-owners.

options.title: Gate only `/learn` entry
options.body: Block non-owner `/learn` requests but leave direct tool lifecycle calls and generic `/approve` same-chat behavior unchanged, which is narrower but likely incomplete.

options.title: Harden all same-chat approvals
options.body: Change the generic empty-approver fallback for plugin and exec approvals, which may be safer globally but has broader compatibility impact.

recommendation.title: Gate Skill Workshop lifecycle writes
recommendation.body: Require owner/operator.admin or an explicit configured approver for `/learn`-driven Skill Workshop lifecycle approval and direct `skill_workshop` apply/reject/quarantine paths, with regression tests for authorized non-owners.

likelyOwner.reason: The current affected lines across the command, tool, and approval surfaces blame to the same commit authored as Peter Steinberger.
